system.cost: One Cost Category Higher Than Item Cost
system.description:
If you want a nanofabricator to make something, you need to instruct the device how to create it from the molecular level up. Such blueprints are available for almost every conceivable item out there. The cost of such blueprints typically exceeds the cost of purchasing the item, though factors like legality and quality may affect the cost as usual (see Acquiring Gear, p. 296).

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 328.
